status: Proposed; implementation and measured validation pending
owner_scope: All 17 champions; initial five-form low-poly images, then scoped implementation, validation and local Linux installation. No push or public deployment.

champions.shape: Exposed skull, narrow split fencing jacket, curved forearm blade and compact chain; no hood or staff.
champions.weapon: Short articulated chain crescent; chain stays coiled near the forearm between attacks.
champions.projectile: None; one small crescent contact streak, never a simulated ranged attack.
champions.idle: Checks the wrist chain and tilts the bare skull; jacket tails counter-sway.
champions.walk: Quick heel-to-toe fencing steps, chain wrist tucked; no sliding or long swinging chain.
champions.attack: Coils wrist, diagonal hook at the authoritative hit, then reels the blade back close.
champions.special: A short green crescent tightens at the blade when the target qualifies for the finisher.
champions.victory: Two heel taps, wrist-chain twirl held vertically, blade-over-heart bow.
champions.death: Knees fold in sequence; chain slackens, blade settles beside the body; soul clasp dims.
champions.space: Tall narrow crescent profile; chain does not contribute to idle lateral radius; jacket is above the feet.

champions.shape: Bare skull in front of a mourning fan, bell-shaped skirt and one large handbell; no wizard hood or pole.
champions.weapon: Broad bronze handbell with one rigid clapper socket.
champions.projectile: Soft green bell ripple travels from the bell to the healed ally; echo uses a single small wrist glyph.
champions.idle: Bell breath-sway and gentle free-hand finger opening.
champions.walk: Short processional steps; bell lags the shoulder and the fan stays vertical.
champions.attack: Raises bell, sounds one measured toll, then presents the free palm toward the patient.
champions.special: Echo rune closes once when nonlethal HP damage consumes it; no resurrection or death cancellation.
champions.victory: Three alternating bell swings, two small side steps and a ceremonial fan bow.
champions.death: Kneels holding the bell upright; clapper stops last and the head bows into the fan.
champions.space: Vertical fan and chest-level bell; skirt hem stays above feet and does not spread into adjacent figures.

champions.shape: Lean wedge-shaped lizard, small hornless head, one broad chisel forearm and one tiny balancing arm.
champions.weapon: One asymmetric slab claw; broad planar cutting edge rather than two identical weapons.
champions.projectile: None; short flat turquoise shard fan at melee contact, capped and immediately fading.
champions.idle: Lowers the small shoulder, flexes the single heavy claw and balances with the tail.
champions.walk: Uneven quick stride with a counter-rotating small arm; weight never reads as a Tank.
champions.attack: Low compact slash; empowered sweep has visible shoulder coil and a longer recovery.
champions.special: A shallow wedge on the ground marks the local sweep; no displacement or stun.
champions.victory: Three claw-tip ground taps followed by a compact shoulder shimmy.
champions.death: Heavy claw touches first; narrow body folds behind it and head rests on its edge.
champions.space: Claw carried along forward lane axis; attack arc is local and not an oversized horizontal disk.

champions.shape: Low long-backed four-legged panther-lizard, broad saber fangs and swept ears; never a humanoid werewolf.
champions.weapon: Jaw and paired saber fangs; tail is a rearward visual counterweight.
champions.projectile: None; one small fang flash on the charged first melee hit.
champions.idle: Alternating forepaw knead, small ear turns and slow tail coil.
champions.walk: Diagonal feline four-beat gait, head low; charge changes posture without added movement.
champions.attack: Draws the head back and bites at normal melee reach; no jump across targets.
champions.special: Fang bases acquire a restrained turquoise readiness glint, removed immediately by qualifying control.
champions.victory: Two front-paw steps, a grounded back stretch and a small head shake.
champions.death: Forelegs bend, chest settles, rear folds afterward; tail follows without a ragdoll.
champions.space: Longitudinal footprint with close-set feet; tail bends along the body axis instead of sweeping lateral lanes.

champions.shape: Slim upright porcupine reptile with a vertical fan of five broad quills, round snout and upright throwing needle.
champions.weapon: One bone needle in hand and a compact dorsal supply fan; no bow or gun.
champions.projectile: Ivory straight needle with turquoise binding; empowered shot leaves a short narrow line to one secondary victim.
champions.idle: Selects one quill and checks its straightness; head makes short alert turns.
champions.walk: Light steps, vertical needle tucked and quill fan rigid over the back.
champions.attack: Overhand needle throw with a matching nocked prop hide/reload, release before impact.
champions.special: A second thin needle trace is shown only when the server reports a valid piercing secondary.
champions.victory: Balances the needle vertically, lets the quill fan ripple once and catches it.
champions.death: Needle lowers first, fan folds backward as the body sits and rolls slightly aside.
champions.space: Quills are tall rather than wide; needle remains upright outside attack and no infinite line trails.

champions.shape: Squat toad with broad triangular head, shallow stone bowl and vertical spoon staff; no plant humanoid or mushrooms.
champions.weapon: Spoon-shaped reed and stone broth bowl; tools stay clear of the face.
champions.projectile: Single turquoise medicinal droplet; quiet regeneration is a small reed-shaped glyph, no large healing fog.
champions.idle: Slow throat breath, gentle bowl tilt and one wrist stir.
champions.walk: Short webbed-foot steps, bowl stabilized and spoon following the stride.
champions.attack: Scoops broth, tips the spoon and releases one droplet toward the patient.
champions.special: Regeneration glyph disappears on actual HP damage; protected hits do not invent damage.
champions.victory: Bowl-balanced two-step, three spoon stirs and a pleased throat bob.
champions.death: Protects the bowl, sits down, spoon slides to the ground and eyelids lower.
champions.space: Wide low head but short limbs; bowl is front-centered and reed staff is vertical, not a large lateral branch.

champions.shape: Compact upright cave mole-bat, wide flat spade head, two vertical crescent ear trumpets and flat ribbed ivory sternum; short neck, no throat sac.
champions.weapon: Paired crescent ear trumpets and ribbed sternum; no handheld weapon.
champions.projectile: Short concentric turquoise sound wedges at the victim, not a traveling physical missile.
champions.idle: Ear fins alternate tiny listening tilts; short neck stays still.
champions.walk: Compact digitigrade steps, ear fins counterbalance close to the head.
champions.attack: Small jaw jab and one focused sound pulse; feet remain planted.
champions.special: Ear trumpets cant forward and the sternum contracts before a short interrupting cry.
champions.victory: Three silent ear-fan beats, alternating finger taps and one small proud head lift.
champions.death: Throat deflates first, hands meet the ground, long neck bows last.
champions.space: Crescent ears grow vertically; folded fins and a short tail stay within the resting shoulder envelope.

champions.shape: Light spear fencer with triangular chest harness and narrow open sun crest; no shield or winged archer silhouette.
champions.weapon: Long solar spear with one clear spearhead; stows almost vertical between attacks.
champions.projectile: None; one gold spear contact glint and one small consumable spark glyph on the primary victim.
champions.idle: Rolls the spear grip and shifts to a balanced fencing guard.
champions.walk: Light high-knee approach with a compact vertical spear and fixed crest.
champions.attack: Linear planted-foot thrust, rear hand follows the haft and recoils exactly after contact.
champions.special: An ally melee strike consumes the single victim spark in one small gold cross-flash.
champions.victory: Four-step lance salute, shaft half-roll close to chest and a forward nod.
champions.death: Spear braces, knee touches, grip releases and crest tips forward.
champions.space: Long spear aligns with lane axis; no broad flag; crest is thin and vertical.

champions.shape: Compact athletic duelist, asymmetric short waist panels, split sun/moon halo and two strongly different curved blades.
champions.weapon: Gold solar saber right, ivory lunar crescent left; both remain close to the torso in crowds.
champions.projectile: None; gold or cool-ivory narrow contact crescent selected by the authoritative alternating counter.
champions.idle: Alternating blade grip checks; half-halo and waist panels overlap softly.
champions.walk: Cross-step fencing walk with no root spin and blades carried down at distinct angles.
champions.attack: Right solar cut alternates with left lunar hook; one actual hit per basic cycle.
champions.special: Lunar self-heal flash only follows actual unit HP damage, never shield damage or tower hits.
champions.victory: Two compact crossing steps, sun blade up and moon blade down, then reverses the pose.
champions.death: Blades cross protectively, knees fold and the half-halo settles close to the back.
champions.space: Blades describe compact forearm arcs; no world-yaw spinning or wide skirt.

champions.shape: Lean connected ivory construct with one star inset face and huge two-handed crystal hammer; no skull or bulky Justiciar fists.
champions.weapon: Faceted star-cage hammer; heavy head carried above/along the forward axis.
champions.projectile: None; short gold/blue planar hammer impact; no meteor or persistent terrain effect.
champions.idle: Checks the hammer balance, exposed joints make tiny rigid settling motions.
champions.walk: Grounded deliberate stride with visibly counterweighted hammer; not the heavy Tank march.
champions.attack: Clear two-hand overhead anticipation, contact on Hit, visible recovery; no invented extra damage frames.
champions.special: A restrained star pressure glyph appears on eligible high-base-HP enemy hits.
champions.victory: Hammer rests vertically; two alternating heel lifts and one proud overhead half-raise.
champions.death: Hammer head touches ground, shoulders fold around shaft and star face dims.
champions.space: Large prop stays vertical in rest and follows a short overhead arc; body remains narrow.

champions.shape: Short bell-shaped healer coat, exposed round face and a circular lantern held with both hands; no wizard staff or head halo.
champions.weapon: One chest-height sunrise lantern; hands grip separate fixed rim sockets.
champions.projectile: A compact warm light mote from the lantern; contextual heal bonus is a small bright lantern-rim pulse.
champions.idle: Gently cradles lantern and breathes; shoulder collar counter-sways.
champions.walk: Small steady steps; keeps the lantern level and turns the head toward the patient.
champions.attack: Raises the lantern a little, opens its shutters, sends one light mote and closes them.
champions.special: Front-pressure bonus is snapshotted at preparation; no permanent aura or unlimited enemy-count scaling.
champions.victory: Two-step lantern cradle dance, gentle dip and a short sunrise presentation.
champions.death: Kneels protecting the lantern, shutters close and the glow extinguishes last.
champions.space: Lantern stays within torso/front volume; collar is narrow, coat hem stays above ankles.

champions.shape: Angular short cape, geometric brow band and forearm-braced triangular prism; no tall staff, bow or halo.
champions.weapon: Gold fork and triangular crystal braced to right forearm; left fingertips adjust the focus.
champions.projectile: Basic tiny azure shard; special uses one thin fixed segment warning followed by a single bounded beam.
champions.idle: Turns the prism minutely and checks a short geometric sight line.
champions.walk: Measured cross-steps, prism braced close to shoulder and cape kept short.
champions.attack: Aligns fork, releases a single shard and restores the forearm guard.
champions.special: Warning segment is fixed at cast start and remains fixed; beam resolves once without tracking targets.
champions.victory: Traces a small triangle with the focus, shoulder sway and brief prism presentation.
champions.death: Prism lowers, left hand catches the fork and body folds to the side; crystal dims intact.
champions.space: Prism and cape are diagonal but close; beam is flat along the BattleLine rather than a screen-filling shaft.

champions.shape: Ant with bent antennae, narrow waist, two tool arms and four planted legs; one serrated blade, no Mantis scythe arms.
champions.weapon: One flat mandible sword, teeth are broad geometric notches rather than tiny saw noise.
champions.projectile: None; compact serrated contact streak and existing bounded bleed indicator.
champions.idle: Antenna alternation and a small mandible sword test with no full-body sway.
champions.walk: Four-foot alternating ant gait; sword points along the lane and abdomen stays steady.
champions.attack: Low single serrated pull-cut; no extra hits from the tooth animation.
champions.special: Bleed uses the existing strongest refresh family and cleanup rules; no new venom stack.
champions.victory: Four-foot marching shuffle, antenna salute and a diagonal blade tap.
champions.death: Four legs tuck sequentially and sword rests on its flat side; antennae lower last.
champions.space: Additional feet tuck under the narrow thorax; blade is diagonal-forward rather than sideways.

champions.shape: Small lean click-beetle with arched thorax and glowing faceted abdomen, two short claws and four small feet; no Tank shell.
champions.weapon: Short striking foreclaws and the organic abdomen; no metal bomb or modern fuse.
champions.projectile: None; one bounded near-death amber pop with flat shard shapes, no recursive explosions.
champions.idle: Small thorax spring compression and contained abdomen light pulses.
champions.walk: Fast springy four-foot scuttle; shell lids remain close to abdomen.
champions.attack: Short paired-claw jab presented as one basic hit, followed by a visible spring recoil.
champions.special: Combat death resolves one capped local damage burst; sale or replacement never triggers it.
champions.victory: Two tiny grounded clicks, abdomen sway and shell-lid bow; no victory explosion.
champions.death: Legs compress, shell opens a little and the single server-authorized pop plays before the body settles.
champions.space: Abdomen is mostly longitudinal; no wide wing opening, explosion visuals never push crowd members.

champions.shape: Dragonfly with long narrow abdomen, large focused eyes, four planted legs and four narrow folded wing planes.
champions.weapon: Organic needle guide on the forearm, natural ivory needle; no rifle or metal scope.
champions.projectile: Thin straight ivory needle with a tiny amber tip; charged version gets one short dark-amber tail.
champions.idle: Eye/head tracking and a very small wing fold twitch; never hovers.
champions.walk: Four-foot measured walking gait with rearward wing panels and stable needle guide.
champions.attack: Braces the guide, releases the needle, then makes one precise reload motion.
champions.special: Opportunity bonus checks the locked target windup at impact; it never interrupts or reads player intentions.
champions.victory: Needle-guide salute, two paired wing clicks and a small four-foot step pattern.
champions.death: Needle guide lowers, abdomen rests, wings fold together and head bows.
champions.space: Wing planes kept nearly vertical, folded rearward; aim line and projectile stay narrow.

champions.shape: Rounded bee medic, short apron, two compact upright wings, honey bowl and short curved dipper; no queen crown.
champions.weapon: Honey bowl in left hand, curved dipper in right; one controlled nectar thread.
champions.projectile: No ballistic shot; one thin amber thread joins current patient only while a real channel is active.
champions.idle: Stirs once and checks the honey thread; antennae tilt asymmetrically.
champions.walk: Small four-foot rocking walk, honey bowl stable and wing panels tucked.
champions.attack: Starts the bounded heal channel instead of performing another normal heal cycle.
champions.special: Patient remains locked for the channel; pulses stop on death, incapacity or loss of range.
champions.victory: Honey-dipper stir, bowl-balanced heel taps and a little wing flutter close to the back.
champions.death: Dipper rests across bowl, legs fold and channel thread snaps immediately.
champions.space: Round abdomen is compact, wings upright; thread is a thin line rather than a wide healing cone.

champions.shape: Thin cicada, folded wing cape, four narrow legs and dominant ribbed chest resonator; no spider web or instrument.
champions.weapon: Natural thorax resonator opened by two arm gestures; no handheld staff.
champions.projectile: Small amber sound chevrons; standard Slow indicator stays separate from decorative ripples.
champions.idle: Antenna metronome and shallow chest bellows with wings still.
champions.walk: Four-foot staccato steps, chest upright and folded wings tracking the back.
champions.attack: One focused rib squeeze and small jab pulse, no hidden multi-hit sound damage.
champions.special: Announced resonator opening applies standard non-stacking Slow to at most two close enemies.
champions.victory: Three-beat thorax accordion gesture, alternating foot taps and an antenna bow.
champions.death: Resonator closes, wings fold tighter and four legs sink in sequence.
champions.space: Tall narrow chest and close folded wings; sound chevrons have a short lifetime and no lateral screen wash.

body_identity: Owner rule 2026-11-01: remove body affiliation plaques and their trim; fixed intrinsic materials on every Evolution, identical for both seats. Team ownership uses foot rings only.
